params.body:
## Why

After #509 the owner saw "Bezig… 28 van 630 slides" (stocklist integration on: own fleet plus the shared stock) and had no way to stop the build.

## What changed

- **Stoppen.** While the state is `running` a quiet `ui-link-btn` "Stoppen" stands next to the busy button (44 px tap height on a phone via `min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0`, both already in the Tailwind build). `POST settings/showroom/download/cancel` (`SettingsController::showroomZipCancel`, dealer-scoped like the other three) calls `ShowroomZip::cancel()`: state `cancelled` plus a stop flag under its own cache key `showroom-zip:{dealer}:stop`. The flag has its own key because the job writes its progress into the state entry after every slide; a `cancelled` inside that entry could be overwritten a moment later and the click would be lost.
- **`BuildShowroomZip`** reads the flag before every slide and before chaining the next batch, and a queued batch that finds the state `cancelled` does the same: partial zip deleted, state and flag cleared (`ShowroomZip::discard`), the job ends without failing. A stop yields nothing, on purpose. A `cancelled` state that no job ever cleans up (dead worker) is swept after the same 15 minutes as a stale run.
- **Tab.** While cancelled the busy button reads "Stoppen…" and the link is gone; the poll sees idle, shows "Download" again and notifies "Gestopt." (`ui.notify`, info tone).
- **Count sentence.** With the stocklist integration on, the helper sentence starts with "630 slides: eigen wagenpark plus gedeelde stock." (nl/fr/en/de) so the size is no surprise. The selection moved from the job into `ShowroomZip::vehicleIds()` so the tab and the job count the same set.
- Rule S2-7.16 updated.

## Tests

`ShowroomDownloadTest` +4: cancel endpoint marks a running build cancelled and sets the flag, is a no-op when idle, another dealer cannot stop it; the job stops at the next slide after a cancel (renderer that presses Stoppen while drawing the first slide: one slide drawn, no zip, no state, flag cleared); a cancel between two batches ends the chain (nothing pushed, state gone); the running tab renders the Stoppen link, its handler and the cancel route; the sentence names the count when the integration is on. Run: `ShowroomDownloadTest` (22), `SettingsPhoneLayoutTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`: 40 tests, 208 assertions, OK (1 pre-existing incomplete).

## Screenshots

Running state with the Stoppen link and the count sentence at 1440 and 390 (link measured at 44 px on the phone), verified on a local server. No hot shared files touched.
params.title: Showroom download can be stopped while it builds
